notes.title: An update on ctrl
notes.notes: You can now use Q/E/Z/C as diagonal direction inputs. At the cost of that, you can only use WASD/JKUI layout now. The ZXCV/Arrow controls are disabled as there are no diagonal keys for them.

notes.title: An announcement
notes.notes:
I must inform that I decided to end this game at Day4 and leave EA soon. This game is too long and too hard for most players even in its current state. So I think it must reach its end.
You may lose your current game progress after updating the game. This is because I will improve the saving system in the full version and I made some change on current saving system to make it compatible  with the future update. I'm sorry for that but I think you didn't go far so it's not a big loss. This will not happen in future versions so it's safe to start a new game now.
The full version will complete the secret system for each day, have a better saving management, and many other improvements to make it a complete game. I may consider adding the rest chapters but I have no budget for now.

notes.notes: Fixed some bugs in Day4 that may lead player to unwanted regions.
